desc: Derive feasibility conditions: R must be even when R>0; if R=0 then B must be even (parity argument: orthogonal edges flip checkerboard parity, diagonal edges preserve it; for R=0 the r-coordinate parity flips each diagonal move).
Design red skeleton, blue staircase gadget, and R=0 blue cycle constructions.
Implement the complete general constructor in Python.
Confirm coordinates stay within [1,1e9] and no duplicate squares for max R+B (sum <= 2e5).
Build independent special-judge validator (counts, distinctness, range, every edge incl. closing edge).
Cross-check feasibility formula vs brute force for small R+B and validate a broad sweep.
Emit byte-exact sample placements (incl. trailing space on "R 3 2 ") for (2,3) and (4,0); confirmed via literalcheck, samplecheck, and selfcheck — public sample PASSED.
